name: oeis-sequences-benchmark
description:
OEIS Next Term Prediction Dataset
	

This dataset provides a benchmark for evaluating models on their ability to predict the next term in integer sequences sourced from the Online Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS).

	
		
		Introduction
	

This dataset introduces a new benchmark focused on integer sequence prediction, leveraging the vast database of integer sequences from the Online Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS).
